data: Which of these words are represented in the pie chart?

The question asks which words are represented in the pie chart. From the caption, we know that the pie chart shows the distribution of question types based on their initial word or multi-word expression. The words listed in the caption are "what," "aux," "how," "other," "why," "when," "who," and "where." These words are also shown in the pie chart. Therefore, all the words listed in the caption are represented in the pie chart.
